test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Tendency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is **"Tendency." **
 
• **"Tendency" **refers to** an inclination or predisposition towards a particular action or behavior.**
 
 
• Examples: "She has a **tendency **to procrastinate" or "His **tendency **towards risk-taking often leads to financial losses."
 
 
 
• The other options - **"Tendensy," "Tendincy,"** and **"Tendancy" **- are all incorrect spellings.
 
• Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.
